prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding injuries sustained in a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes. Our client was seriously hurt and is now receiving medical treatment, and we expect the resulting claim to be substantial.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured or any representative of your company has been in contact with our client, please note that our client is represented and that all inquiries should now come through us.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy under which your insured is covered, along with any other policies that may apply, including umbrella or excess coverage.

We also ask that your company and your insured preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and telematics, dash camera footage, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, and any repair or total loss records. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
